Possible illegal mining related: The police found the bodies of nine men and
two women inside a dilapidated building at an abandoned old Blaauwbank gold
mine. Other victims were taken to the hospital.

Tavern killing: A group of armed males stormed into a tavern and started
shooting at patrons randomly.

Taxi related: It is alleged that five men were driving around Mamelodi East
when they were kidnapped and taken to Cullinan by the members allegedly
affiliated to Mamelodi Taxi Association and Mamelodi long distance taxi
association. The victims were tied up, assaulted and set alight inside a taxi. The
deceased were accused of stealing taxis and one of them was alleged to be
affiliated to Tembisa Taxi Association.

Security guards killed in the line of duty :Five security guards were shot and
killed at an open cast chrome mine when attacked by illegal miners.
